markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 现在完成进行时说的是**从过去一直做到现在**的事：可能还在做，也可能刚停下、看得出痕迹。重点是**做了多久**。

uses.zh: 从过去开始，现在还在做
uses.en_zh: 我已经等了二十分钟了。

uses.en: Your eyes are red. [[Have]] you [[been staring]] at the screen <<all day>>?
uses.en_zh: 你眼睛都红了，一整天都盯着屏幕吗？

uses.zh: 最近一段时间一直在做
uses.en: We[['ve been working]] on the new design <<lately>>.
uses.en_zh: 我们最近一直在做新设计。

positive.title: 肯定句
positive.rule: 三块拼起来：**have / has + been + 动词 ing**。他她它用 has，其他用 have。been 永远不变。

examples.en: I[['ve been learning]] English <<for>> two years.

examples.zh: 从早上开始一直在下雨。

examples.en: The team [[has been fixing]] bugs <<all week>>.
examples.zh: 团队这一整周都在修 bug。

negq.title: 否定和疑问
negq.rule: 否定：在 have / has 后面加 not。疑问：把 have / has 搬到最前面，been 和 ing 跟在后面不动。

examples.en: She [[hasn't been coming]] to the stand-ups.
[[Has]] Mia [[been working]] from home this week?
examples.zh: Mia 这周一直在家办公吗？

howlong.title: 说「多久了」
howlong.text: 这个时态最爱和「多久」一起用：**for** 加一段时间，**since** 加开始的那个点，问的时候用 **How long**。

items.zh: 我已经学了三个小时了。
他从一月起就在这儿工作。

items.rule: How long + have / has + 主语 + been + ing？

notes: know、like、want、have（拥有）这类「状态」词不加 ing，改用现在完成时：I[['ve known]] him <<for>> years.

traces.title: 看得出痕迹
traces.text: 事情刚停下，但现在还看得出来：人很累、地上是湿的、手上有油漆。这时用它说**刚才一直在做什么**。

examples.en: I'm out of breath because I[['ve been running]].
examples.zh: 我喘不过气，因为我刚才一直在跑。

examples.en: The ground is wet. It[['s been raining]].
examples.zh: 地上湿了，刚才一直在下雨。

examples.en: You look tired. [[Have]] you [[been working]] late?
examples.zh: 你看起来很累，最近一直加班到很晚吗？

this.meaning: 一直在做，看过程：做了多久

that.meaning: 做完了，看结果：做了多少

this.meaning: 从过去到现在，说了做了多久

commonMistakes.bad: I ~~am waiting~~ here for an hour.
commonMistakes.good: I[['ve been waiting]] here <<for>> an hour.
commonMistakes.why: 说「已经多久了」，不能只用现在进行时。
know 是状态，用现在完成时，不加 ing。

commonMistakes.bad: We've been ~~work~~ on it since May.
commonMistakes.good: We[['ve been working]] on it <<since>> May.
commonMistakes.why: been 后面的动词要加 ing。

commonMistakes.bad: I~~'ve been drinking~~ three cups of tea today.
commonMistakes.good: I[['ve had]] three cups of tea today.
commonMistakes.why: 说了数量（三杯），重点是结果，用现在完成时。

quiz.prompt: I ___ for you for twenty minutes! Where are you?
quiz.explain: 从二十分钟前一直等到现在：[[have been waiting]]。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我们最近一直在做新设计。
quiz.answer: We've been working on the new design lately.
accept: We have been working on the new design lately.
We've been working on the new design recently.
We have been working on the new design recently.
quiz.explain: 最近一直在做：We[['ve been working]]。

quiz.prompt: 改成否定句：She has been sleeping well.
accept: She has not been sleeping well.

traps.input: She doesn't have been sleeping well.
traps.note: 直接在 has 后面加 not。

quiz.explain: She [[hasn't been sleeping]]：has 后面加 not。

quiz.prompt: 改成一般疑问句：You have been waiting long.
quiz.explain: 把 [[Have]] 搬到最前面，been waiting 不动。

quiz.prompt: 改错：We've been work on it since May.
quiz.answer: We've been working on it since May.
accept: We have been working on it since May.
quiz.explain: been 后面要加 ing：[[been working]]。
January 是开始的那个点，用 <<since>>。

quiz.prompt: 针对划线部分提问：I've been learning Swift for a year.（问对方「多久」）
quiz.answer: How long have you been learning Swift?

traps.input: How long are you learning Swift?
traps.note: 问「已经多久了」用 have been + ing。

quiz.explain: 三个小时是一段时间，用 <<for>>。

quiz.prompt: — Why are you out of breath? — I ___.
quiz.explain: 刚停下，还喘着气，看得出痕迹：[[have been running]]。

quiz.prompt: Your hands are covered in paint. What ___ you ___ (do)?
quiz.explain: 手上有油漆是痕迹：What [[have]] you [[been doing]]？
说了数量（十个），看结果：[[have written]]。

quiz.prompt: I ___ tests all morning, and I'm really tired.
quiz.explain: <<all morning>> 说的是做了多久，看过程：[[have been writing]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：I've been knowing her for years.
accept: I have known her for years.
quiz.explain: know 是状态，不加 ing：I[['ve known]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：I am waiting here for an hour.
quiz.answer: I've been waiting here for an hour.
accept: I have been waiting here for an hour.
quiz.explain: 说已经多久了：I[['ve been waiting]]。

openTask.prompt: 用现在完成进行时说 3 句话：你最近一直在忙什么、忙了多久。至少一句用 for，一句用 since。
rules: 结构 = have / has + been + 动词 ing
for 后面跟一段时间，since 后面跟开始的时间点
know、like 这类状态动词改用现在完成时
openTask.note: 规则判 have / has been + ing 和 for / since（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
